$note: FK columns to EXCLUDE from dependency-OBJECT discovery in the export walk. A column here references an object (so CMF metadata treats it as a dependency edge) but is NOT the object's real dependency in this context — following it pulls the wrong record into a dependency sheet. The column's value STILL exports on the object's own sheet; this only stops it from driving the dependency walk. Keyed ObjectType -> [column names] (case-insensitive). Example: Step.QueuedStorageService / Step.ProcessedStorageService point at a STORAGE service (e.g. WAITING_STORAGE), not the step's process service (which comes from ServiceContext) — following them wrongly puts the storage service in the Service sheet instead of the real service. Also handles BOGUS metadata refs: Flow.Type is a string enum (Standard/Rework/Storage) but CMF metadata declares it referenceTargetType=Area — following it seeds Area discovery with 'Standard' (not an area), which fetches 0 rows and wrongly marks Area done before the real areas arrive from the steps, leaving the Area sheet empty. Consumed by lib/chat-cmf/export-with-deps.ts (refCols + forwardNames).
